H = home · A = away. Averages use the displayed venue filter. This is a fictional schedule for demonstrating the tool; it is not the current Premier League calendar.

How to read the radar

Start with the average, then look at the individual fixtures. A good overall run can still contain a difficult match. The demo rating combines opponent strength and venue; it is a planning cue, not a points prediction.

Each club has a sample strength from 2 to 5. Playing at home reduces the opponent’s strength rating by one; away fixtures keep it unchanged. Ratings are clamped between 1 and 5. The average is calculated only from fixtures visible under your venue filter.
